title: Loan

field.name: Name
field.drawdownDateHelp: When the money was paid out. Interest accrues from this date to the first instalment.
field.paymentDayHelp: Moved to the last day of the month in months that are shorter.

amortization.ANNUITY_help: The instalment stays level between rate changes. When the rate changes, the instalment is recalculated and the end date stays put.

dayCount.MONTHLY_NOMINAL_help: Every month counts as exactly a twelfth of a year. What most public loan calculators use.
dayCount.ACT_360_help: Real elapsed days over a 360-day year. Common in Nordic and continental lending, and slightly more expensive than a nominal twelfth.
dayCount.ACT_365_help: Real elapsed days over a 365-day year.
dayCount.THIRTY_360_EU_help: Every month treated as 30 days, both dates capped at the 30th.
dayCount.THIRTY_360_US_help: Every month treated as 30 days, using the US bond convention.

dayCountNotice: Check this against your loan agreement. Over a full term the choice can change the total interest by thousands.

rate.marginHelp: Added to the reference rate. Your agreement states it in percentage points or basis points.
rate.referenceFloorHelp: Many agreements stop the reference rate going below 0%, so a negative reference does not reduce your margin.
rate.capHelp: The bank caps the reference rate for a fixed period, for a fee. Worth taking only if rates rise far enough, for long enough, to save more than the fee costs.
rate.hasCap: This loan has a rate cap
rate.capCeilingHelp: This caps the reference rate before your margin is added. If your agreement caps the total rate instead, subtract your margin from the figure it states.
rate.capPremiumHelp: Usually quoted as an addition to your margin, and charged for the whole capped period whether or not the cap ever takes effect.
rate.capOpenEnded: Runs to the end of the loan

summary.interestShare: Interest is {{percent}} of what you borrowed

form.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and all its scenarios? This cannot be undone.

validation.firstPaymentBeforeDrawdown: The first instalment cannot come before the drawdown date
validation.capBelowFloor: A cap below the floor could never take effect
validation.capEndsBeforeStart: The cap cannot end before it starts
